description: The dependency updates of SAK, docs/development/DEPENDENCIES.md

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

dependencyDashboardFooter: Not updated by Renovate, update these by hand (docs/development/DEPENDENCIES.md): the Android SDK in `mise.toml` (the command-line tools with their sha1, `ANDROID_BUILD_TOOLS`, the platform and the system image), the Hetzner server image `debian-13` in sak-cloud, the major version of Java (`mise.toml`, the Gradle toolchain, `openjdk*-jre` in `sak-backend/Dockerfile`).

customManagers.description: A version in a Dockerfile ARG, with a renovate comment on the line before it
The pinned images of the ansible roles, <name>_image: docker.io/<image>:<tag>@<digest>

packageRules.description: One PR a week for each ecosystem with its minor and patch updates
The npm dependencies apart from the dev dependencies, which merge automatically
Merged when the workflow is green: the actions, the npm dev dependencies, the crates
Before 1.0 a minor version can break the api (cargo), so by hand
The releases of nextest are tagged cargo-nextest-<version>
Kotlin of the backend build and the android build together
Tauri: the cli of mise.toml and the crates must have the same version
Playwright: the java library of sak-e2e and the npm package of sak-frontend, with the same browsers
Ansible: the package of the tools image, ansible-core of mise.toml and the collections; ansible <n> contains a fixed ansible-core 2.<m>
A major version of Java changes the toolchain and the image of the backend too, by hand
Images and majors only by hand: the workflow does not run the integration and e2e tests
